meaning: Immutable roadmap bookkeeping, not full-simulator percentage. Every applicable G1-G10 and package-specific gate must pass before closure.

items.section: Completion contract shared by every slice
items.source_text: State equations, units, normalization, spatial/temporal centering, admissible inputs and model limits. Specify which conservation identities are discrete, convergent, statistical or inapplicable because a boundary/source exchanges them.

items.section: Completion contract shared by every slice
items.source_text: Name canonical owners and every affected caller. Preserve documented constructors and checkpoint readers or provide an explicit schema/API migration. Share physics kernels where the equations agree; distinct discretizations need distinct state, not duplicated physical policy or a universal speculative framework.

items.section: Completion contract shared by every slice
items.source_text: Freeze baseline source, resolved dependencies, machine configuration and inputs before editing. Retain failures and rejected candidates. Complete the pre-edit brief and at least three wrong-patch/mutant challenges.

items.section: Completion contract shared by every slice
items.source_text: Test exact/manufactured solutions, independent discrete oracles and held-out invariants; vary dimensions, precision, signs, empty populations, shape order, species, grid parity, crossings and timestep histories. Use timestep/grid/particle refinement separately so noise does not masquerade as truncation error.

items.section: Completion contract shared by every slice
items.source_text: Exercise nonfinite/out-of-range inputs, aliases, invalid configuration, resource limits, incomplete solves and I/O failure. Define the commit point; before it, rejection restores public physical state, clocks and persistent phase. State precisely whether RNG/scratch may advance. Distributed transport failure is distinct from recoverable collective validation failure.

items.section: Completion contract shared by every slice
items.source_text: Verify uninterrupted versus restarted evolution, corrupted/versioned input, ownership, object cleanup and same-environment reproducibility. Cross-backend or changed-rank continuation needs numerical/statistical equivalence unless a deterministic reduction/order contract has actually been implemented.

items.section: Completion contract shared by every slice
items.source_text: Run minimum-supported and latest-stable Julia in exact-source environments; record actual versions. Run focused tests, neighbors, Aqua, concrete JET and full package JET trees. Classify every changed report; a lower count is not a diagnosis.

items.section: Completion contract shared by every slice
items.source_text: Run real devices/ranks when claimed. A skip, emulation, `COMM_SELF` run or CPU conversion is not a hardware/cluster pass. Required unavailable checks stay open.

items.section: Completion contract shared by every slice
items.source_text: Complete fixed performance gates below, then independently audit the whole dataflow from a different entry point, including restart/error paths and tests' ability to reject wrong implementations.

items.section: Completion contract shared by every slice
items.source_text: Update examples, model support table, diagnostics and restart schema. Commit and push each accepted implementation/fix separately to `main`; require the entire required exact-revision GitHub matrix green, or retain explicit evidence of a billing block. Preserve hardware/large validation results separately from ordinary GitHub CI.
Cell-local self/cross pairing with empty/singleton/odd populations, arbitrary species counts/weights, shared physical-rate arithmetic, alias rejection and staging before velocity publication.

Independent drift/diffusion, equilibration-rate, conservation, scaling, cross-cell isolation, fixed-RNG replay and legacy regression suites are part of the accepted CPU tests. Ordinary reusable-workspace calls are allocation-free.
Broader complete-call cost campaign, extreme occupancy/species imbalance, production workload and independently controlled timing acceptance.
CAP-010 supplies fixed-step first-order isothermal CPU composition and full advanced-RNG/phase restart.

Accept the implemented ideal evolving-scalar, S1/S2 transport and S3b conduction extensions through exact-revision GitHub CI; ion-ion collisions leave pressure fixed, while existing field stages provide the applicable Ohmic/hyperresistive heat and conduction. Accepted at `b5ce21a`: [run 41683122086](https://github.com/jake-w-liu/HybridPlasmaPIC.jl/actions/runs/41683122086) ran all four collisional test files on Julia 1.12.7 and 1.13.3, with every job green. Resource acceptance remains open in [the guide](COLLISIONAL_HYBRID.md#verification-status).

Accept actual-pencil [collisional ES](DISTRIBUTED_COLLISIONAL_ELECTROSTATIC.md) and [EM sources](DISTRIBUTED_COLLISIONAL_EMPIC.md): migrated populations pass an explicit canonical collision-cell ownership gate, use owned logical bins/global dx and persist full per-rank RNG/physical state. Actual-rank/statistical/restart acceptance and broader MPI families remain open; CAP-004 must still supply real device pairing/streams.

**002A: Maxwell vacuum/cavity.** Dimension-parametric staggered state, periodic cross-check and conducting walls; explicit centering/CFL contract; compatible curl/divergence and field-energy/Poynting diagnostics. Gate cavity frequencies, analytic pulse transport, reflection phase and spatial/time order at multiple modes, incidence directions and corner configurations.

**002B prerequisite: closed longitudinal charge/current.** Extensive nodal CIC charge and endpoint path impulse are implemented for CPU Float32/64 with exact range replay and atomic output publication. Their scalar path voltage shares the same overlap geometry and stored-dx work metric. Optional finite physical-width triangular-cloud static coupling adds a continuous stationary work-adjoint field, with explicit particle-bound endpoint tails and distinct wall response. Native voltage/cloud arithmetic and resource acceptance remain open. GitHub verification is pending; see [the scoped contract](BOUNDED_PARTICLE_COUPLING_PLAN.md).

**002B: bounded particle coupling.** Deposit the complete trajectory before removal/injection; split multi-cell and multi-face crossings, preserve IDs and species charge, account for wall surface charge/current. Gate discrete local continuity including boundary flux, Gauss propagation, particle-field work, reflecting-wall energy, exact free-flight crossing maps and empty populations. An event-free longitudinal electrostatic `YeeLongitudinalPIC` source candidate now supplies synchronized cloud Verlet coupling, exact background/free-plate initialization, diagnostics and distinct checkpoint/archive state. Its [scoped contract and GitHub gates](BOUNDED_PARTICLE_COUPLING_PLAN.md#event-free-longitudinal-coupled-source-candidate) do not accept transverse EM coupling or wall events. `YeeElectromagneticPIC` now adds a distinct event-free 1D3V source candidate: both polarizations, exact compatible transverse currents/PEC mask, synchronized Boris/Yee stages, scoped combined-rest/physical-H exit guards, diagnostics and complete schema-2 restart. [Contract and pending GitHub gates](BOUNDED_PARTICLE_COUPLING_PLAN.md#event-free-1d3v-electromagnetic-source-candidate) do not accept general nonlinear stability, wall events or broader bounded EM. Both coupled source candidates now retain complete rational original-geometry gathers, q/m and full-dt half through canonical Boris, rounding only final half-kick velocities. Their schema-2 force policy rejects the former schema-1 rounded-gather map. Exact-revision runtime/compiler/format and complete-step resource acceptance remain pending; ordinary native bits are not preserved. The distinct [`YeeImpactLongitudinalPIC` source candidate](YEE_IMPACT_LONGITUDINAL.md) now implements nonrelativistic CPU Float32/64 finite-cloud reflection on a closed longitudinal 1D grid: zero contacts or one connected certified cluster per external step, original-factor forces and at most two rational-duration synchronized KDK chunks. Conservative carried state/source/time bounds check the full remainder from the original external-step state; ledgers, diagnostics and distinct restart stage before publication. Exact-revision GitHub numerical, independent force-driven convergence, rollback/restart, JET/compiler, formatting/CI and complete-step resource acceptance remain pending. Broader wall laws, multiple clusters, transverse walls, relativity and backend integration remain open. The distinct [`YeeAbsorbingLongitudinalPIC` source candidate](YEE_ABSORBING_LONGITUDINAL.md) adds zero or one uniquely isolated certified-passive instantaneous full-cloud capture per external step in the same closed nonrelativistic CPU Float32/64 longitudinal 1D domain. It retains original-force rational-duration KDK, full death current, dynamic exact plate and capture ledgers, stable Vector compaction and distinct restart. Its survivor carry handles the finite force jump separately from reflection's fixed-source contract. Exact-head GitHub numerical/convergence, rollback/restart, JET/compiler, formatting/CI and resource acceptance remain pending. General material/sheath laws, multiple captures, transverse walls and backends remain open; **002B is not complete**.

**002C: absorbing/radiating boundaries.** Add a measured absorbing layer with configurable thickness/profile and accounted energy removal; inject external fields/particles with explicit energy/charge budgets. Gate reflection spectra versus angle/frequency/resolution and long-time stability, including face/edge/corner layers and particle exits through them.

**002D: production integration.** Relativistic and subcycled species, restart including layer/surface state and half-time fields; CAP-003 halos, CAP-004 resident kernels and external bounded-plasma comparisons under CAP-007.

**003A: layout/storage.** Explicit owned/ghost regions, cell volumes, staggered locations where relevant, communicator lifecycle and physical-boundary ownership. Gate unequal partitions, thin/empty allowed partitions, all directions, periodic seams and shape-radius halos; reject impossible layouts collectively.

**003B: distributed operators.** Reuse FFT plans and implement derivative, curl, Laplacian, projection/filter and normalization in actual pencil layouts. Gate analytic modes, DC/Nyquist, divergence/curl identities, transpose/inverse parity and preallocated plan reuse on 2/4/8 real ranks. Mixed nonperiodic SBP/Fourier operators are a separate accepted backend, not a periodic shortcut. Evidenced at `b5ce21a`: the real MPI jobs of [run 41683122086](https://github.com/jake-w-liu/HybridPlasmaPIC.jl/actions/runs/41683122086) ran the distributed FFT, derivative, operator, projection/filter, inverse-range and workspace-allocation suites at 2, 4 and 8 ranks with no failures. Stage E timing and transport inventory remain open in the [operator plan](DISTRIBUTED_OPERATOR_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md); scaling is 003E.

**003C: moments and full hybrid step.** Deposit local/ghost contributions, sum ghost moments once, apply species/rank summation before floors, then solve local fields and gather with complete halos. Migrate across any crossed domains before the next owner-dependent operation. Gate serial-reference trajectories, budgets, pressure, variable-step phases and collections across rank boundaries.

**003D: production families.** Extend accepted composition to ES/EM, full-Hall shocks, collisions and open boundaries; attach rank-local diagnostics, partition-aware checkpoint and restart to each actual solver family.

**003E: scaling.** Real multi-node strong/weak scaling and load imbalance campaigns, plus restart on supported changed layouts. Use no full-field gather in the measured hot path; account separately for explicitly requested output.

**004A: kernel contract closure.** Audit deposit/gather, push, wrapping, moments, pressure, sorting/growth and reductions on real hardware; include shape boundaries, empty/block-edge counts, invalid input/rollback and large index ranges. Metal primitive controls exist; the resident CUDA candidate now supplies D1 CIC particle/coupling kernels and remote device controls, with execution and broader kernel/model coverage still open. Preserve honest precision support.

**004B: one complete periodic solver.** Build storage/operator support and one complete hybrid stepping path with scalar algebraic closure, including initialization, diagnostics and restart. No per-step field/particle host copy, host scalar indexing or hidden CPU solve. If a backend cannot supply the chosen device FFT/operator, leave that solver/backend unsupported until implemented.

**004C: full family coverage.** Add evolving/CGL closures, collections, CAM-CL, ES/EM including relativistic/current-correction paths, collisions, boundaries and all persistent phase state as separate composed slices.

**004D: multi-GPU.** Combine CAP-003 ownership with measured direct-device or explicitly reported host-staged communication, device/RNG ownership, rank migration and restart. Hardware support must be detected and tested per path.

**005A: audit existing implicit-labelled paths.** The shock path now supplies a converged, true-residual-checked frozen-moment CN solve with explicit tolerances/iteration limits and staged whole-step publication. Its [scoped source and verification record](SHOCK_CN_SOLVE_PLAN.md) retains the former approximation as history. Complete current-revision residual, amplification/timestep-range and assembled-system acceptance; align `recommended_dt` with the actual coupled resolution limits. This broader milestone remains open.

**005B: residual and transaction.** The new synchronous family implements joint velocity/B represented residuals, frozen dimensionless block scales, absolute/relative tolerance, bounded Newton/GMRES/probe/backtracking budgets and private candidate ownership. Fresh final gates precede full publication; typed failures preserve public state and prior report by source dataflow. No timestep retry occurs. Independent numerical and transaction acceptance remain open; see the [complete contract](IMPLICIT_HYBRID.md).

**005C: coupled hybrid.** Periodic isothermal CPU collections, full-time fields/particles and complete fixed-policy/report persistence are source- implemented. Strict density and canonical original-factor Boris/moment/field owners are reused. Canonical evolving-pressure source is integrated with exact third-block/work and complete schema2/raw/archive continuation controls pending; orbit averaging, selected dissipative terms and preconditioning remain open. Accept the actual spatial/particle residual, phase/order, work and momentum errors and restart before advancing this milestone; the represented defect report is not exact conservation.

**005D: implicit EM and broader geometry.** EM requires its own coupled Maxwell/charge-current equations; it is not an automatic hybrid mode. Integrate compatible boundaries, domain ownership and device execution only after the corresponding explicit operator contracts pass.

Define physical versus logical particle coordinates, vector/covector components, Jacobian-weighted densities, axis/outer-boundary regularity and equilibrium representation. Extend `curvilinear_mesh.jl` with the compatible curl/field solve and volume/face measures required by the selected hybrid model.

Implement geometry-aware deposit/gather with a proved discrete work identity; evolve actual particle populations and fields on `ToroidalGrid`. Retain the existing metric utilities as tested components, not the stepper.
Add equilibrium loading, boundaries, full restart and volume-weighted energy/flux/particle diagnostics. Then add CAP-003/004 ownership and devices.

Choose and document a complete model before implementation: proposed first slice is electrostatic gyrokinetic ions with adiabatic electrons, explicit equilibrium, ordering and long-wavelength/polarization approximation. Introduce a distribution/marker population with owned weights, parallel velocity, magnetic moment and equilibrium parameters; the existing single `GuidingCentre` remains a local-field utility. [SLAB_GYROKINETIC.md](SLAB_GYROKINETIC.md) documents the full-f electrostatic ions, modified adiabatic electrons, uniform equilibrium and long-wavelength polarization. `GyrocentreSet` owns positions, `vpar`, `mu` and weights; the stepper derives the uniform equilibrium density from the marker inventory.

Implement marker evolution, gyroaveraged deposition/interpolation and the matching quasineutrality/polarization field equation, with gauge/nullspace handling and a free-energy diagnostic derived from the same approximation. Full-f versus delta-f is an explicit model decision, not a runtime fallback.

Add geometry and collision integration, restart of weights/equilibrium/RNG, then kinetic electrons and electromagnetic potentials with their own energy balance. Couple Raycon heating only through CAP-010's accounted source contract.

Add an owned hierarchy of patches, valid/ghost regions, refinement ratios, tagging/regridding and covered-cell accounting. Existing `AMRGrid` only stores one scalar 1D level; its transfer arithmetic remains the local oracle.

First couple a static hierarchy to electrostatic PIC with a composite field solve, charge normalization, particle ownership and compatible gather. Then implement moving refinement, conservative remap and synchronized time evolution; do not claim adaptive evolution from a `refine` return value.

Extend to hybrid/EM with flux/current synchronization, divergence and charge constraints, time interpolation/subcycling and coarse/fine correction derived for the actual solver. Add distributed partition/rebalance and device storage after serial hierarchy correctness.

items.section: CAP-007 — independent validation and comparative evidence
items.source_text: **007A: reproducible references.** Pin NHDS/Hybrid-VPIC source revisions, patches, compiler/build options, input decks, checksums, units, license and raw outputs. The [shared provenance implementation](EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_PROVENANCE_PLAN.md) replaces moving clones and unchecked cache reuse. Real pinned builds and all ten unchanged physics metrics pass on Julia 1.12.7 and 1.13.2; pushed as `95c5678`, with all six exact-SHA CI jobs and full compiler review complete. Missing/build-failed references stay failed/unavailable. This metadata does not establish a hermetic toolchain. The original run's six job logs were rechecked on 2026-11-04; see the provenance plan's progress list.

items.section: CAP-007 — independent validation and comparative evidence
items.source_text: **007B: production dispersion.** Keep the independent eigenvalue comparison in case 27, but also measure frequencies/damping/growth from actual initialized hybrid/Hall/EM time series and compare with the applicable independent theory or solver. Sweep modes, angles, temperature/mass ratios and refinement; freeze fitting windows, uncertainty estimation and branch selection before results. The [existing frequency helper repair](VALIDATION_FREQUENCY_PLAN.md) is a prerequisite: 3,153 registered checks, compiler/resource review and actual case 20 pass per runtime; correction `27372b2` has six green CI jobs and a complete compiler-tree review. This does not close the broader campaign. The [first production matrix](PRODUCTION_DISPERSION_PLAN.md) now passes all 324 metrics on both runtimes across 40 cold parallel profiles and six timestep-order histories. Corrected long-history fitting, actual test sandboxes, independent raw-data replay and CLI/plot integration pass locally; the slice is pushed as `839c109`. Minimum-Julia CI exposed twelve fitter residual failures; its other five jobs passed. The [observation-centering repair](MODE_HISTORY_CENTERING_PLAN.md) retains that evidence and all original thresholds. Oblique, thermal, kinetic and EM regimes remain open.

items.section: CAP-007 — independent validation and comparative evidence
items.source_text: **007C: nonlinear profiles.** Reproduce matched shock setups, including initialization, boundary conditions, closures and diagnostics. Compare full density/B/velocity/pressure profiles and time statistics, not just peak scalar agreement. Add full Preisser dataset replay with checksummed downloads and parameter mapping; do not infer it from the bundled summary roundtrip.

items.section: CAP-007 — independent validation and comparative evidence
items.source_text: **007D: expanded physics.** Benchmark bounded EM against an independent PIC solver, collisional equilibration against an independent kinetic reference, toroidal orbits/gyrokinetics against matched references, and AMR against uniform fine-grid solutions plus independent code. For reconnection, distinguish resistive versus collisionless mechanisms and measure reconnection rate, topology and energy partition beyond mode amplification.

items.section: CAP-007 — independent validation and comparative evidence
items.source_text: **007E: fair cost/accuracy campaigns.** Pin hardware/software and problems; compare accuracy/uncertainty, runtime, peak memory, scaling, setup and restart costs. Publish raw measurements and unsuccessful cases. Scope every comparative claim to the actual problems and machines; no single benchmark establishes worldwide superiority.
